rows.english: That highest of Victors, the Great Fifth of the Dalai Lamas, has said as well, What happened before? Someone has been in my mind for time with no beginning. When was that? There's never been a moment when they were gone. Who are they? I live, and live again, the mental afflictions. And in the end? They will leave me to rot in the ocean of suffering life, without an end in sight. And the karma? It comes like the wind, with all the things I never wanted. How far? It whips around me everywhere, and stirs great waves, the three forms of suffering. How long? I could wander around this sea forever; the torch would spin, and the circle of light would blaze. What should I see? Think on this, and see that the afflictions of the mind are the one true enemy. What must be done? The enemy of living for this life must die. Who shall do it? You will have to pretend that you are warrior enough to be the one. When will it come? Your foes, the afflictions in your mind, have always been there waiting, ready for the battle. Now then? The time has surely come: go forth now and defeat them.60

rows.english: If you have been sleeping the second way, imagine that you waken all in a flash, as the Angel Herself, from a state of emptiness, from great bliss and the clear light. Try hard to imagine then that the place and other things around you are all perfectly excellent.

rows.acip: BSGRUBS PA'I NANG MCHOD LAS LAG GA YON PA'I MTHEB SRIN GYIS BLANGS TE 'BRU GSUM BRJOD PA DANG SBRAGS LAG GA YAS PA'I MTHIL DU AOm RANG GI MDUN TSUR NGOS DANG, A'A: GA YAS, H'Um GA YON DU GNAS PAR BSAMS TE RTZE MO RANG LA BSTAN PA'I CHOS 'BYUNG GA YON SKOR DU BRIS PA'I DBUS NAS BDE STONG GNYIS SU MED PA'I YE SHES BDUD RTZI'I RNAM PAR SHAR BA'I SNYING PO BLANG BAR MOS NAS RANG LHAR GSAL BA'I LCER MYANG BA BAm YIG LA THIM PAS SNYIGS MA BSREGS, DVANGS MAS TSIMS NAS LUS THAMS CAD BDE BA CHEN PO'I YE SHES KYI BDUD RTZIS GANG ZHING, SDIG SGRIB NYES LTUNG THAMS CAD DAG PAR MOS SHING,
rows.wylie: bsgrubs pa'i nang mchod las lag ga yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te 'bru gsum brjod pa dang sbrags lag ga yas pa'i mthil du aoM rang gi mdun tshur ngos dang, a'a: ga yas, hUM ga yon du gnas par bsams te rtse mo rang la bstan pa'i chos 'byung ga yon skor du bris pa'i dbus nas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bdud rtsi'i rnam par shar ba'i snying po blang bar mos nas rang lhar gsal ba'i lcer myang ba baM yig la thim pas snyigs ma bsregs, dvangs mas tshims nas lus thams cad bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing, sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par mos shing
rows.english: Hold this now in your right hand, and take out some of the liquid with the thumb and ring finger of your left hand.  As you say the three holy letters, draw a dharma star on the palm of your right hand, going around to the left as you make the lines.  The top corner of the star should be facing you, and imagine that the letter om is on the corner towards you; the ah is to the right; and the hung is to the left. Now pick up the liquid from the center of the star, with a strong feeling that you are taking up the very essence of wisdom which is made of bliss and emptiness inseparably combined, appearing in the form of nectar.  See yourself as the Angel, and touch the nectar to Your tongue. The nectar comes down and melts into the vam letter.  It burns away all the dregs inside, and fills you with refined essence.  Try to feel strongly that you are satiated with nectar of the wisdom of great bliss, and that all your bad deeds and obscurations, all the wrongful acts and downfalls you have committed against your vows and pledges, are completely cleaned away.

rows.english: What this all means is that, because he or she has not attained recognition of the clear light by force of their work with their winds, then this individual who is able to maintain meditative concentration in their sleep has not managed to get the three types of emptiness to appear, as we described earlier, first--and the fact is that they must appear prior to the clear light of sleep. rows.acip: DES NA 'OD GSAL RLUNG STOBS KYIS ZIN PA MIN PAS, GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA LA NI GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI SNGON DU 'CHAR DGOS PA'I STONG PA GSUM SNGAR BSHAD PA DE MI 'CHAR BAS, DE GSUM SNGON DU MI 'CHAR BA'I GNYID KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL GYI DON MED DO,,
rows.wylie: des na 'od gsal rlung stobs kyis zin pa min pas, gnyid ting nge 'dzin du skyed nus pa la ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi sngon du 'char dgos pa'i stong pa gsum sngar bshad pa de mi 'char bas, de gsum sngon du mi 'char ba'i gnyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gsal dvangs byung yang, gnyid kyi 'od gsal gyi don med do
rows.english: What this all means is that, because he or she has not attained recognition of the clear light by force of their work with their winds, then this individual who is able to maintain meditative concentration in their sleep has not managed to get the three types of emptiness to appear, as we described earlier, first--and the fact is that they must appear prior to the clear light of sleep.  And although it may be true that you can achieve a meditative concentration within your sleep which is extremely lucid even without these three having made their appearance, this is not what the "clear light of sleep" refers to.

rows.acip: DE'I PHYIR GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL LA NYAMS DANG RTOGS PA'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, SRAB MO DANG 'THUG PO'I 'OD GSAL GNYIS DANG, RMI LAM GYI DUS SU RTOG MED KYI TING NGE 'DZIN GSAL DVANGS BYUNG BA YANG, GNYID KYI 'OD GSAL DU 'JOG PA'I RNAM GZHAG MANG PO SNANG YANG SNGAR BSHAD PA LTAR MA PHYED PAR GNYID TING NGE 'DZIN DU SKYED NUS PA TZAM GYI STENG NAS BSHAD PA MANG DU BYAS PAR SNANG BAS, YID BRTAN THUB PA MI SNANG NGO,,

rows.english: And so it is that the clear light of sleep can be discussed in terms of the two of a feeling of clear light and an actual experience of clear light; and in terms of the two of a less deep state of clear light and a deeper state of it; and in terms of a clear and lucid state of non-conceptual concentration that comes in your dreams.  And despite the fact that many presentations on the clear light of sleep have been written, a great number of them give their explanation based on nothing more than teaching the ability to turn sleep into a state of meditative concentration, without making any of the distinctions we've just mentioned.  As such it does not appear that we should accept these words as authoritative.

The staff is white, as though it were made of butter, and seems almost about to melt.
